content.text:
Listen only to the attached 30.000-second recording. Author factual English
sound captions for Deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers, directly from the audio.
Do not guess the video, story, characters, visible actions, emotional reactions,
or causes. No external captions or story context are supplied. Do not transcribe
spoken words: speech recognition is handled separately. Include identifiable
music, sound effects and nonverbal vocalizations. Omit uncertain source identities;
use a general acoustic label instead. Silence needs no caption. Do not invent a
sound merely to fill an interval. Distinct events may overlap; include music under
effects if audible. Estimate each event's LOCAL start/end in seconds, within the
recording. A continuous sound can span the whole clip. Up to 12 events.
Return only JSON: {"cues":[{"start_s":0.0,"end_s":1.0,"essential":"short sound label",
"balanced":"brief factual sound description","detailed":"more acoustic detail, at most 25 words"}]}.
All three texts must describe the SAME audible event; greater detail must not
add a new sound, unsupported source, meaning or emotion. Plain text without brackets.
Return {"cues":[]} if no identifiable non-speech sounds are audible.
